data.summary:
Investment Banking Operations professional with 7.7+ years of experience across Corporate Actions, Securities Operations, Asset Servicing, Middle Office, Trade Settlements, Trade Lifecycle Management, and Fund Accounting within global financial institutions.
Proven expertise in processing Mandatory and Voluntary Corporate Actions, SWIFT message validation, trade settlements, reconciliation, exception management, and operational risk controls across global markets.
Experienced in collaborating with Front Office, Middle Office, Custody, Fund Accounting, Technology, Client Service, and Operations teams to deliver operational excellence, strengthen governance, improve Straight Through Processing (STP), and enhance client experience.
Demonstrated success in leading teams, driving automation initiatives, improving operational efficiency, and managing critical market events while maintaining regulatory compliance and high service quality.

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE	
Senior Securities Specialist – Corporate Actions	February 2023 – Present
UBS
Hyderabad
Lead a team of six analysts supporting end-to-end Corporate Actions processing across global markets, ensuring SLA adherence, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and high-quality client service.
Process Mandatory and Voluntary Corporate Action events including Dividends, Rights Issues, Tender Offers, Stock Splits, Mergers, and Spin-offs.
Manage the complete Corporate Action lifecycle including event capture, validation, entitlement processing, election management, settlement, and client reporting.
Review and validate SWIFT MT564, MT566, and MT568 messages, ensuring accurate interpretation and timely processing of market events.
Performed entitlement validation, cash and stock reconciliations, SmartStream TLM exception investigations, and operational risk mitigation to ensure accurate client positions and timely settlements.
Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Custody, Fund Accounting, Technology, Client Service, and Operations teams to resolve high-priority operational issues.
Present governance updates, KPI dashboards, and operational metrics to senior stakeholders.
Led automation and process improvement initiatives that improved operational efficiency by 20%, reduced manual intervention, and enhanced Straight Through Processing (STP).
Reviewed and validated Management Fee and Performance Fee calculations, investigating exceptions and coordinating with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.
Utilized SmartStream TLM to monitor reconciliations, investigate operational exceptions, resolve trade breaks, and improve Straight Through Processing (STP).
Maintained and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) to support accurate settlement processing and mitigate settlement risk.
Supported end-to-end trade lifecycle activities by partnering with Front Office, Middle Office, Custody, Fund Accounting, and Technology teams to resolve operational issues.
Conducted pre-settlement validations and ensured accurate processing of Corporate Action entitlements while adhering to internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Participated in process improvement initiatives that enhanced operational efficiency, reduced manual intervention, and strengthened operational controls.
Achieved 98% query resolution within 24 hours while maintaining zero operational losses during critical market events.
Trade Settlements Analyst May 2022 – November 2022 Accenture Processed Hong Kong Equity trade settlements for global investment banking clients. Managed settlement processing, trade validation, reconciliation, and settlement monitoring activities. Investigated settlement failures, unmatched trades, and booking discrepancies. Coordinated with brokers, custodians, and internal Operations teams to resolve settlement exceptions within SLA. Performed exception management and operational risk mitigation, contributing to a 15% reduction in settlement failures. Improved settlement turnaround by 10% through proactive monitoring and issue resolution. Bengaluru Middle Office Analyst – Hedge Funds May 2020 – May 2022
State Street
Hyderabad
Supported end-to-end Trade Lifecycle Management across Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Hedge Fund products.
Performed trade processing, trade validation, settlement support, and lifecycle event management.
Worked closely with Fund Accounting, NAV, Pricing, Custody, and Client Service teams to ensure accurate trade processing.
Performed cash and position reconciliations while investigating trade breaks and operational exceptions.
Supported trade booking validation and settlement monitoring across multiple investment products.
Coordinated with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Custodians, and global Operations teams to resolve trade-related issues.
Automated operational reporting and workflow improvements, reducing processing time by 25%.
Maintained 100% trade booking accuracy while ensuring adherence to internal controls.
Supported NAV preparation, validation, and release activities, ensuring timely portfolio valuation and coordination with Fund Accounting teams
Performed Management Fee and Performance Fee calculations, validation, and exception resolution in accordance with fund documentation and client requirements.
Utilized SmartStream TLM to monitor reconciliations, investigate exceptions, resolve trade breaks, and improve Straight Through Processing (STP).
Maintained and validated Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) to ensure accurate settlement processing and minimize settlement failures.
Worked closely with Fund Accounting, Custody, Pricing, and Operations teams to resolve NAV, reconciliation, and settlement-related exceptions within SLA.
Corporate Actions Analyst	October 2018 – May 2020
Wipro Limited (UBS)
Hyderabad
Processed Mandatory and Voluntary Corporate Action events across global markets.
Reviewed and interpreted SWIFT MT564, MT566, and MT568 Corporate Action messages.
Processed Dividends, Rights Issues, Tender Offers, Bonus Issues, Stock Splits, and Mergers.
Performed entitlement validation, event elections, booking verification, reconciliation, and operational break investigation.
Investigated operational exceptions, booking discrepancies, and entitlement breaks while ensuring timely resolution in accordance with operational procedures.
Produced governance reports and KPI dashboards while ensuring compliance with global operating procedures.
